compiled_state.title: T2: RED — Implement ticket-update-rav.sh read-after-write wrapper
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Goal
Create plugins/dso/scripts/ticket-update-rav.sh that wraps ticket mutations with a read-after-write assertion. Prior art: ticket-edit.sh for event model.

## Files to Create
- plugins/dso/scripts/ticket-update-rav.sh

## Operations Covered
create, edit (field updates), tag/untag, transition, link, comment

## Logic
1. Execute the ticket mutation (pass-through to existing ticket CLI)
2. Re-read the ticket via ticket show
3. Assert the written value matches intended value
4. On mismatch: exit 1 with JSON {operation, ticket_id, field, intended_value, actual_value, timestamp}
5. On match: exit 0 (pass-through exit code from underlying mutation)

## Acceptance Criteria
- chmod +x plugins/dso/scripts/ticket-update-rav.sh
- bash tests/scripts/test-ticket-update-rav.sh exits 0 (all 6 cases GREEN)
- Does not add latency on success path (single re-read only, no polling)

## Testing Mode
RED (depends S10/T1)
